meta.description: The single source of truth for reverse-skill task routing. master-route.ps1 / verify-routing-coherence.ps1 / test-routing.ps1 / extract-summaries.ps1 all read from this file. To modify routing rules, please only change this file and do not alter the routing tables scattered in markdown / ps1 (the documentation is maintained by the generation script, or at least kept consistent with this site).
meta.scoring: Each keyword rule hit is counted into the candidate set; according to the order of the priority array, the one with the 'highest hit score' is taken as PRIMARY; if scores are tied, the one earlier in priority wins; if no rule is hit, fallbackId is used.
maintainers: The priority table in references/MASTER-ROUTING.md corresponds one-to-one with the priority field in this file
references/scripts/verify-routing-coherence.ps1 will check the consistency between the two
